name: Swagger
description: Work with your APIs and documentation through natural conversation using Swagger. Generate APIs from natural language, explore and search your API library with full context, and validate specifications against organizational governance policies. Automatically standardize and fix non-compliant APIs, and create, manage, and publish documentation portals and API definitions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Swagger to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Swagger to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://swagger.mcp.smartbear.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Swagger MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Swagger lists 22 MCP tools, including list_portals, get_portal, create_portal, update_portal, list_portal_products, get_portal_product, create_portal_product, update_portal_product, delete_portal_product, publish_portal_product, list_portal_product_sections, and create_table_of_contents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Swagger?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Swagger in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Swagger requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Swagger is developed by SmartBear. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
